✨ Card Smartfill

AI smart fill for the card studio. It only fills what your text or screenshot says, never made-up teams or numbers.

✨ Smart fill

  1. Show the bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B) and drag the blue button onto it.
  2. Get a free Gemini API key at aistudio.google.com/apikey.
  3. Open the studio, pick a card, click the ✨ Smart fill bookmark.
  4. Paste your key once, paste the match info (or drop an eFootball result screenshot), press Fill this card.

The key stays in your browser only (Forget key removes it). Built 2026-10-22, 27 KB.
